data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 双手捧稳的双层汉堡
data.description: 明亮的快餐店里，阿尔托莉雅穿深蓝针织开衫、白色翻领衬衫和裙装坐在桌旁，双手分别托住双层芝士汉堡的两侧，小心张口咬下一口。她的碧绿眼睛专注地看着汉堡，脸颊微微鼓起，金色盘发上的蓝丝带整齐垂落。桌上是素色纸托盘与一杯饮料，大片窗光照亮她满足的神情。
data.action: 双手托住双层汉堡两侧，微微前倾咬下一口，目光落在食物上。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
data.promptProse: A double cheeseburger nearly fills both of Artoria Pendragon’s hands as she leans forward for a bite at a fast-food table. The knight from Fate/stay night wears a dark-blue knit cardigan over a white collared shirt and skirt. Her green eyes follow the food, cheeks gently rounded; a blue ribbon secures her blonde braided bun beneath an upright ahoge. Broad window light reaches her pleased face and a plain paper tray with one drink. Frame one seated diner at table height, no lettering.
